verdict.rationale: Plugin source is publicly readable: the openai/plugins GitHub repo hosts plugin directories (figma, build-ios-apps, build-web-apps, expo, notion) with their manifests, skills, and MCP wiring, and the marketplace.json and openai/skills sources can be fetched raw from GitHub. However, nothing in the evidence states which license these repos use, so the 'under an open license' half of the story is unverified. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license on the plugins/skills repos, evidence that the core plugin runtime/host source (not just the bundled plugins) is published, and independent corroboration of open licensing.
